written.headline: SWE-CoWork benchmark reveals coding agents complete under 8% of real software tasks
written.summary: A new benchmark of 101 development assignments across real repositories shows leading AI coding agents pass about 63% of fail-to-pass tests but fully complete fewer than 8% of tasks. The study places agents in a simulated engineering organization with 26 virtual colleagues.

written.headline: Researchers show LLMs can program tabular foundation models by editing weights and caches
written.summary: A paper by Shi Bin Hoo and colleagues shows that GPT-6 Astra can directly program tabular foundation models by setting weights and editing KV caches, without gradient-based optimization. Astra programmed nanoTabPFN from zero-initialized weights to a mean ROC AUC of 0.849 across 20 TabArena datasets, versus 0.876 for a pretrained baseline.
